content: Application Growth Check submission: visit https://developer.ebay.com/my/support/tickets?tab=app-check while logged into eBay Developer Program account, complete form (all fields marked with red asterisk are required; hover info icon for field-specific guidance), can 'Save as Draft' to pause and resume, then 'Submit'. This is the same portal used to request restricted API access including Marketplace Insights API. It is a free service; eBay's team reviews for compliance with Application Growth Check requirements. No published SLA/turnaround time is stated on the docs page.
